investment_policy_en:
The Portfolio Manager follows a disciplined, fundamentally-driven bottom-up security selection approach to generate long-term capital growth. The PM seeks companies with durable competitive advantages, operating in growing end markets with compelling barriers to entry. The philosophy focuses on owning quality stocks with high incremental returns on investment that can compound earnings growth faster than the market and are trading at reasonable valuations, and seeks to exploit behavioural and analytical inefficiencies, such as time horizon arbitrage, loss aversion and short-term extrapolation, to drive outperformance.

The fund aims to achieve capital growth over the long term.

The fund invests at least 70% (and normally 75%) of its assets, in equities of companies that are headquartered or do most of their business in the US. The fund may also invest in money market instruments on an ancillary basis.
